"""Bad: TLS verification disabled; the pragma is not accepted for LINT-10."""
import ssl


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    context.check_hostname = False
    context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return ctx.http.get("https://" + entity.value, verify=False)  # v3lum-lint: allow LINT-10 -- legacy appliance
